A standalone standard-library program recomputes every nonstandard finite step and prints VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The Nauru graph is the canonical 24-vertex cubic symmetric star Cayley graph with full group S4 times S3. In a mixed-degree rational homology setting of dimensions four and one, the natural question is how all graph symmetries act. The exact decomposition as an S4 sign-twisted four-point permutation module further twisted by S3 sign, and a differently twisted one-dimensional degree-six module, reveals distinctions invisible from ordinary wedge counts; the full quotient is rationally acyclic but the natural A4 times A3 quotient retains one class in each degree. This is a complete motivated finite symmetry classification, not an arbitrarily sliced numerical invariant.
